hypothesis: Structured preservation of explicit policy constraints changes unsafe approval frequency relative to context window truncation.
pairing: Every condition receives the identical synthetic episode-step inputs; upstream state is fixed by oracle, not the model.
analysis_rule: Report case-level descriptives; confirmatory tests must aggregate by episode and use a pre-registered paired bootstrap or randomisation analysis.

confirmatory_design.note: Must be frozen to positive integers before author approval; not chosen from confirmatory data
